content.short: Liminal helps crypto-native companies securely scale and manage digital assets with plug-and-play wallet architecture.
content.description: Liminal provides scalable infrastructure for crypto-native companies to securely manage their digital assets with a plug-and-play wallet architecture. Its security-first approach enables projects to implement bespoke policies and assign roles to users based on their responsibilities. The zero-key leakage tolerance approach helps reduce transfer risks, supporting teams in countering cyber threats, guarding against internal collusion, and minimizing human error in asset transfers.
